items.headline: Geneva trader automates trade finance paperwork with AI
items.summary: Centalion (formerly Gunvor) deployed an AI agent that drafts bank guarantees and other trade finance instruments from plain-language instructions, cutting issuance time roughly 55% and amendment time about 80% on its first facility, per PYMNTS.

items.headline: Mitsubishi Electric deal reshapes ETRM vendor landscape
items.summary: Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions is prompting ETRM/CTRM vendor owners to reassess valuations and exit strategies, according to CTRM Center analysis, as the deal signals strong strategic interest in specialist energy software.

items.headline: Container freight rates surge on Middle East tensions
items.summary: Global container freight rates have climbed roughly 130% since February, with a Jefferies-cited report showing tracked rates rising from about $2,000-2,500 to $4,000-4,500 as renewed Middle East tensions disrupt shipping routes.

items.headline: FIA pushes back on ESMA's EMIR 7d reporting plan
items.summary: FIA submitted comments urging ESMA to adopt a targeted, proportionate approach to the proposed EMIR Article 7d reporting framework, warning against duplicative reporting requirements for market participants including commodity derivatives users.
